meta.name: spec-brainstorm
meta.description: Conversational design workshop for new features. Interviews the human one question at a time, explores 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, then produces a focused spec. Combines requirements discovery with codebase research and architecture design. Use when the user says "create a spec", "design this feature", "let's brainstorm", "what should we build", or at the start of any feature/refactor/complex-bug workflow.
